articles.title: GRSE Emerges Lowest Bidder for ONGC’s Four Platform Supply Vessels
articles.description: State-owned defence shipbuilder Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Ltd (GRSE) has emerged as the lowest bidder for the construction of four Platform Supply Vessels (PSVs) for Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC), marking the first commercial shipbuilding tender to be finalised following the Union Cabinet’s approval of the ₹69,725 crore Maritime Development Fund and shipbuilding [...] The post GRSE Emerges Lowest Bidder for ONGC’s Four Platform Supply Vessels appeared first on India Seatrade News .

articles.title: India News | KTR Serves Legal Notice on CM Revanth Reddy, Demands Apology for Linking Him to Globe Arena Technologies
articles.description: Get latest articles and stories on India at LatestLY. Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) Working President KT Rama Rao on Thursday served a legal notice on Chief Minister Revanth Reddy, demanding that he tender an unconditional public apology within 48 hours for allegedly linking him to Globe Arena Technologies and "falsely branding" it as his benami company.
